svg.text: Deferral curve: cascade accuracy vs share of queries sent to the LLM classifier
Eval-1000, cached Gemma 4 E4B verdicts. Each deferred query costs ~0.9 s of local inference.
Dots mark the shipped threshold (0.65). Area under curve: v1 0.947 · v0 0.946 · random 0.935 · oracle 0.968
Share of queries deferred to the LLM classifier
